paper.title: Seer: Accelerating Blockchain Transaction Execution by Fine-Grained Branch Prediction

risks: The artifact was inspected but not executed, so build success, benchmark reproducibility, dependencies, and end-to-end runtime are unverified.
The probe reports a GPU requirement, which reduces hardware portability and may complicate scalable benchmark evaluation.
It is unclear whether all realistic blockchain traces and chain-state snapshots are packaged publicly or require expensive reconstruction.
Blockchain replay may have high storage, initialization, and runtime costs unless the workload is carefully bounded.
The repository has no reported stars and the recent paper has no citations yet, leaving adoption and external validation unknown.
A throughput-only objective could reward workload-specific heuristics; hidden workload families and resource constraints are needed.

host_note: stage0/host.json was not synced off the instance; the machine these numbers were measured on is not recoverable, and measuring this one would name hardware that never ran them

recovered.why: the canonical task directory under stage2/ is not synced off the instance; this was rebuilt from the trace reviewer's copy
